display.purpose: Hero figures (34px), 26px metrics, and the wordmark (uppercase, ~0.14em tracking). Space Grotesk 700.

headline.purpose: The regime badge and the one-sentence market read. Space Grotesk 500–700, 18–20px.

title.purpose: Card titles and table text. IBM Plex Sans 500, 12px.

body.purpose: Prose and memo body. IBM Plex Sans 400, 13px / 1.55, max 74ch.

label.purpose: UPPERCASE mono section labels (11px, +0.5px). Meta 10px +1px; eyebrows/column headers 9px +1.5px.

shadows.name: shadow-float
shadows.purpose: The floating assistant only — the single drop shadow in the system. Everything else is flat.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default exit easing for hovers and fills.

motion.name: pulse-period
motion.purpose: Live-dot pulse (opacity 1→0.35, scale 1→0.86). One pulsing element per screen region.

motion.name: tick-flash
motion.purpose: Directional green/red wash when a value updates.

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat dark panel every module sits in; tone swaps border color only.
components.html:
KEY LEVELS
Hairline border, flat surface, 12px pad.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--surface, #161b22); border: 0.5px solid var(--line-hair, #21262d); border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px; color: var(--text, #e6edf3); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-label { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-label, #8899aa); padding-bottom: 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-hair, #21262d); margin-bottom: 10px; } .ds-card-body { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted, #8b949e); }

components.name: Regime Badge
components.description: States the current macro regime — muted 12% fill / 25% border, never solid.
components.css: .ds-regime-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; background: rgba(218,54,51,.12); color: #f08785; border: 0.5px solid rgba(218,54,51,.25); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 20px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: 0.3px; } .ds-regime-conf { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; opacity: 0.75; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Status Tag
components.description: 9px mono uppercase chip; tones map to meaning, not decoration.
components.html: Watch Clear Triggered
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 3px; padding: 2px 6px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; margin-right: 4px; } .ds-tag-warn { background: rgba(210,153,34,.12); color: #d29922; border: 0.5px solid rgba(210,153,34,.25); } .ds-tag-pos { background: rgba(63,185,80,.12); color: #3fb950; border: 0.5px solid rgba(63,185,80,.25); } .ds-tag-neg { background: rgba(218,54,51,.12); color: #f08785; border: 0.5px solid rgba(218,54,51,.25); }

components.css: .ds-signal { background: var(--surface, #161b22); border: 0.5px solid rgba(210,153,34,.3); border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; max-width: 240px; } .ds-signal-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-signal-name { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text, #e6edf3); } .ds-signal-status { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 9px; color: #d29922; } .ds-signal-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #d29922; } .ds-signal-value { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--text, #e6edf3); } .ds-signal-caption { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 1px; color: var(--text-faint, #484f58); margin-top: 8px; margin-bottom: 3px; } .ds-signal-track { background: var(--surface-raised, #21262d); border-radius: 3px; height: 4px; overflow: hidden; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-signal-fill { background: #d29922; height: 100%; width: 68%; border-radius: 3px; transition: width 420ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1); } .ds-signal-meta { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-faint, #484f58); }

components.name: Alert Row
components.description: One alert-feed entry; the 3px left rail carries the level color.
components.html: WATCHVIX_shockVIX weekly z-score=2.41 — above 2.0 watch threshold.2026-05-01
components.css: .ds-alert { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; background: var(--surface, #161b22); border: 0.5px solid var(--line-hair, #21262d); border-left: 3px solid #d29922; border-radius: 3px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-alert-level { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1.5px; color: #d29922; min-width: 44px; } .ds-alert-name { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text, #e6edf3); } .ds-alert-msg { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted, #8b949e); margin-left: 8px; } .ds-alert-date { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-faint, #484f58); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: Text tabs on a hairline rule; 2px accent underline marks active. Never pills or fills.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #30363d); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tab { appearance: none; background: none; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: var(--text-muted, #8b949e); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; padding: 0 0 10px; margin-bottom: -1px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 140ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1); } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--text-2, #c9d1d9); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #4a9eff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tab-active { border-bottom-color: #4a9eff; color: var(--text, #e6edf3); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Stat Tile
components.description: Label / value / delta triple; ▲ green, ▼ red, → grey; green is 'up', not 'good'.
components.css: .ds-stat { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; color: var(--text-faint, #484f58); margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-stat-value { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--text, #e6edf3); line-height: 1.1; } .ds-stat-delta { font-size: 12px; color: #2ecc71; margin-top: 2px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview: Dark, dense, information-first. The product states, it does not sell — every screen is built from real model output and market data, set in a strict three-face type system on GitHub-dark surfaces with one blue accent. Density is the aesthetic: 12px card padding, 12px grid gaps, hairline borders. If a screen feels empty, the answer is more data, not decoration. The system is awake, not animated: the only motion tells you something changed.
keyCharacteristics: GitHub-dark surface stack (#010409 → #0d1117 → #161b22 → #21262d), flat, no gradients
One brand accent (#4a9eff) that never means "good"
Three typefaces with mechanical jobs; every number is mono with tabular figures
0.5px hairline borders; 3px left rail marks generated/elevated content
Unicode glyph vocabulary (▲ ▼ → ↗ ↘ ◆ ✓ ×) instead of an icon set
Desk-note voice: declarative, present tense, every claim carries its number

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: #4a9eff is the only brand color. It never encodes good/bad — valence belongs exclusively to the directional layer.

rules.name: The 12% Fill Rule
rules.body: Regime and status tints render at 12% fill / 25% border. A solid regime-colored block is always wrong.

rules.name: The Mono Number Rule
rules.body: If it is a figure, label, ticker, timestamp, or column header, it is IBM Plex Mono with tabular-nums — without exception. If it is a headline it is Space Grotesk; otherwise IBM Plex Sans.

rules.name: The Tracking Rule
rules.body: Tracking widens as type shrinks: 0.5px at 11px, 1px at 10px, 1.5px at 9px — and inverts to −0.02em on large mono figures.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: A new shadow anywhere is a defect (the assistant float excepted). If depth is needed, step the surface value.

dos: Do put every number, label, ticker, timestamp, and column header in IBM Plex Mono with tabular figures.
Do give every metric its label, unit, timeframe, and a one-line desk-note caption.
Do use the closed status vocabulary: Clear/Watch/Triggered · info/watch/risk · Risk-On/Risk-Off · Aligned/Diverges.
Do use 0.5px hairlines as the default border and step surface value for depth.
Do state freshness honestly and fall back to latest-available data with its date instead of an empty state.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion on every animation, and keep focus rings always.
Do end anything that leaves the app with "Automated briefing from Macro Regime Radar. Not investment advice."
donts: Don't add an icon library, draw custom SVG icons, or substitute emoji — the glyph vocabulary is Unicode.
Don't use gradients, photography, illustration, texture, blur, or drop shadows (assistant float excepted).
Don't render regime colors as solid blocks — 12% fill / 25% border always.
Don't let #4a9eff mean "good" or use color as the only status channel.
Don't nest cards in cards or add hover background fills outside tables.
Don't soften the terminal: no Inter-everything, no generic-SaaS layouts, no decorative motion, nothing lighter than 400.
Don't show a naked number: every figure ships with label, unit, and timeframe.
